checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Small freestanding chalkboard standing on pavement outside the café
must.why: A small A-frame chalkboard stands on the pavement at the left in front of the café.

must.item: Chalkboard reads exactly 'COFFEE TO GO', all words legible
must.why: It reads COFFEE / TO GO on two lines. The 'TO' and 'GO' are slightly uneven and small, but they are readable.

must.item: Words lie on sign surface with matching perspective
must.why: The text sits on the board face and looks like chalk. The lettering is a bit uneven.

must.item: Plausible ground contact, scale, lighting, shadow
must.why: The scale is plausible, but the shadow is weak and the contact is only so-so. The sign sits directly on the plant and hides it, which looks cramped.

must.item: Original storefront, awning, tables, wide composition intact
must.why: The awning, storefront and tables are unchanged. The plant is mostly hidden by the sign.

exact_text.read_as: COFFEE TO GO (on two lines: COFFEE / TO GO)

faults.what: The sign covers most of the potted plant, which is part of the original scene, so the placement looks awkward.
The shadow and ground contact are weak. The lettering is uneven, with 'TO' and 'GO' misaligned in size.

summary: A small chalkboard sign reading COFFEE TO GO now stands on the pavement and the rest of the photo is intact, but it hides the potted plant and has a weak shadow.
